_comment: Human-authored reconciliation between NPS API unit records and the 63
designated National Parks. Every entry records WHY, because a silent
adjustment here is indistinguishable from a mistake.
include: units that are one of the 63 but whose designation does not match
split:   one NPS unit that represents more than one official park
exclude: units matching the designation filter that are not one of the 63
STATUS: unverified starting point. Run fetch-parks.mjs, read what it
reports, and confirm each entry against nps.gov before relying on it.

include.reason: Redwood National and State Parks is one of the 63. Its NPS designation does not contain the words 'National Park', so the designation filter misses it.

split.reason: Sequoia and Kings Canyon are two separately designated National Parks administered as a single NPS unit. The API returns one record; the collection counts two.
